repos.name: 3d-export
repos.description: A Python-first tool to generate land cover exports and quickly create a 3D-style PNG from Sentinel-2 land cover tiles. Inspired by the original rayshader R workflow.

repos.name: gtfs-transit-platform
repos.description: A generalized data-engineering and geospatial-analytics platform for GTFS transit feeds — ingest any agency's schedule data, run spatial and service-quality analysis, and explore results in an interactive map app.

repos.name: GeoCoder
repos.description: Tools for turning a spreadsheet of US street addresses into geocoded points using free Nominatim and Overpass OpenStreetMap APIs.

repos.name: 3DEP-Lidar-Terrain-Builder
repos.description: Generate DEM, DSM, hillshade, slope, aspect, and contour products from USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) lidar for a user-defined area of interest.

repos.name: Road-Centerline
repos.description: Extract road centerlines from polygon geometries (road contours) — worldwide, in any input CRS, in any format geopandas can read.

repos.name: hazard-mcp
repos.description: MCP server unifying multiple US hazard APIs: OpenFEMA disaster declarations, USGS earthquake feeds, NOAA river gauges, NWS alerts, and NASA fire/wildfire events.

repos.name: surge-exposure
repos.description: Data-engineering pipeline ingesting NOAA storm surge risk layers and flood-inundation polygons, overlaying against building footprints to score per-asset exposure.

repos.name: geospatial-data-copilot
repos.description: Natural-language interface over spatial/infrastructure data — a local LLM agent translates plain-English questions into spatial SQL and answers with a map.

repos.name: RomanNepaliAI
repos.description: Tools for working with Nepali text: transliteration (romanized Nepali ↔ Devanagari) and translation (Nepali ↔ English), live in-browser and via CLI.

repos.name: conversational-ai-assistant
repos.description: LangChain-based conversational chatbot with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), indexing local documents into a Chroma vector store.

repos.name: pywmp_documentation
repos.description: Documentation for pyWMP, an open-source Python watershed modeling and planning tool.
